scope.restriction: No new forecasts, scenarios, capacities, model variants, market designs, CVaR variants, or Honda economics

information_timing.source_limitation: The historical price artifact contains no observation-level publication timestamp; 12:55 is an explicit documentary assumption, not empirically verified archival metadata.

primary_estimand.population: Intersection of days on which P2, P3, and P4 realized schedules satisfy the frozen grid cap
primary_estimand.metric: paired realized wholesale cost difference in EUR/day

secondary_estimand.population: All 273 candidate days after the pre-specified settlement-only feasibility correction
secondary_estimand.metric: paired corrected wholesale cost difference in EUR/day

diagnostic_estimand.metric: paired nominal wholesale cost difference contaminated by realized cap violations

settlement_correction.name: EX_POST_MINIMUM_ZERO_EXPORT_PROJECTION
settlement_correction.schedule_policy: The frozen committed F1 schedule is never changed or reoptimized.
settlement_correction.rule: For realized post-schedule exchange g_t = actual_t + u_t, set external correction c_t = max(0, -g_t) and corrected exchange g_corrected_t = g_t + c_t. This is the unique componentwise minimum nonnegative intervention satisfying the zero-export cap.
settlement_correction.cost_rule: Price corrected exchange with the unchanged historical interval price vector and 0.25 h duration.
settlement_correction.negative_price_guard: Correction cannot exceed the exact violation amount, preventing artificial extra consumption at negative prices.
settlement_correction.information_rule: Actuals are accessed only by the settlement layer after the original schedule is sealed. The correction is an ex-post accounting/feasibility sensitivity, not an implementable forecast-time decision.
settlement_correction.energy_state_rule: Correction is external to the F1 work-buffer state and does not rewrite its terminal condition.

hypotheses.H1: On common-feasible days, S2 does not significantly reduce mean realized wholesale cost relative to deterministic scheduling.
hypotheses.H2: S2 reduces realized zero-export-cap violation frequency relative to deterministic scheduling.
hypotheses.H3: Any S2 advantage is concentrated on days with binding F1 state, F1 power, or realized grid-cap conditions.

statistics.multiplicity: Holm adjustment across exactly three primary common-feasible comparisons

stopping_rule: Stop after this one replication; do not add policies, capacities, scenarios, markets, models, CVaR variants, or Honda economics.
